create_config_context_manager: create a polars Config context manager to temporarily set table formatting and verbose options
build_config_decorator: build a function decorated with pl.Config to scope formatting options to a specific function
test_config_save_load: test saving and loading polars Config state as a JSON string for reproducibility
refactor_config_defaults: refactor polars Config to restore all settings to their default values
summarize_config_state: summarize the current state of all polars Config environment variables and direct settings
